debugData.name: Showcase alpine terrain
debugData.description: terrainShowcase's alpine block (p310 §3.4): seven layers (grass01 the base; grass02, rocks02, cliffs02 and snow01 in the first splat map, snow02 and ice01 in the second) weighed by its two painted splat maps and two rules over them (snow01 above 18 m on slopes under 35° facing north within 70°, broken by the macro noise; cliffs02 past 45°) through the height blend, DUAL_SCALE, the sets as one array (ARRAY storage) sampled sparsely (the top 3 layers a pixel), cliffs02 triplanar past a 35-50° slope gate, the macro variation, and the wet response: puddles on the flats and rain ripples, the snow (snow01) over it by the surface conditions' snow cover, frost below freezing.
